subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - HealthWave (post-demo follow-up)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@healthwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-25T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - HealthWave (post-demo follow-up)

Hi Alex / Samira -

Thanks again for taking time today - great to walk through the platform and the integration points. Per our call, I'm starting the vendor security questionnaire so your security team can review. I've attached the spreadsheet HealthWave sent (HealthWave_SIG_request_v1.xlsx) and our SOC 2 Type II report (Redwood_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf) for context.

Two quick clarifying items before we start:
- Scope: do you want answers scoped to hosted API only, or should we include Dedicated/Private options?
- Data classification: will the SIG be evaluated under PHI-in-scope (HIPAA) or non-PHI SaaS use?

Next steps I propose:
1) We confirm scope and any required attestations (HIPAA BAAs, data residency).
2) Redwood pre-fills obvious fields in the SIG and returns a first draft within 3 business days.
3) HealthWave security reviews + follow-up Qs.

If you prefer CAIQ instead, let me know and I'll switch templates - both are fine.

Attached: HealthWave_SIG_request_v1.xlsx (your original), Redwood_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf (SOC 2 Type II).

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@healthwave.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.k@healthwave.com>
Date: 2026-02-25T17:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - HealthWave (post-demo follow-up)

Thanks Camila - appreciate the quick follow-up and the SOC 2 report. A couple clarifying items from our side: 

1) Scope - For now please scope the responses to hosted API only (we're evaluating hosted first; Dedicated/Private may come later for PHI workloads).
2) HIPAA - We are not sending PHI in the initial pilot; however, HIPAA controls will be required if we move to PHI. Can you confirm whether Redwood offers a BAA and any additional documentation?
3) Pre-filling - yes, please pre-fill any answers you can (we expect your security team to fill admin/process questions). We'll flag items that need legal/security review.

Also timeline: can you get a first draft back by end-of-week? Our security lead (Samira) will be the point reviewer.

Thanks,
Alex
Sr. PM, Integrations - HealthWave
alex.johnson@healthwave.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@healthwave.com>, Samira Khan <samira.k@healthwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-26T09:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - HealthWave (post-demo follow-up)

Alex - great, hosted API scope it is. Quick answers: 

- BAA/HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA customers and we do offer a BAA. I've attached our SOC 2 Type II report for immediate review; BAA language is handled in a separate addendum and we can share our standard BAA template if needed.
- Timeline: we can pre-fill the SIG and return a first draft by EOD Thursday (2 business days). If there are any redlines that require legal review, we'll flag them.

A few clarifying Qs for you (will speed up the pre-fill):
1) Is the SIG expected to include subcontractor/processor mapping for your procurement team? If yes, we'll include a short vendor list.
2) Any special data residency / EU data transfer constraints we should note even for hosted?
3) Are there particular sections you want us to prioritize (e.g., encryption, access controls, incident response)?

I'll loop in Marissa to own the questionnaire completion and follow-ups.

Thanks -
Camila

> On Feb 25, 2026, at 5:03 PM, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@healthwave.com> wrote:

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@healthwave.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@healthwave.com>
Date: 2026-02-27T11:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - HealthWave (post-demo follow-up)

Hi Camila - thanks for the context. A couple follow-ups from security: 

- Please include subcontractor/vendor mapping (we need to know who handles telemetry, logging, and model hosting).
- Prioritize sections: Incident Response, Data Encryption (at-rest + in-transit), Access Controls, and Audit Logs.
- Pre-fill: yes, please pre-fill what you can. We typically mark items as Accepted / Accepted with Evidence / Needs Clarification - if you can add short evidence notes (e.g., link to SOC report page, relevant doc) that'd be helpful.

Timeline: EOD Thursday works - if there are any items that will take longer, flag them to us and we'll triage.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Security Lead - HealthWave
samira.k@healthwave.com

1) I'll draft answers for the prioritized sections (Incident Response, Encryption, Access Controls, Audit Logs) and add evidence notes with page refs to the attached SOC 2 PDF.

3) Target: first draft back to HealthWave by EOD Thursday (2026-03-05). If we need faster, I can try to push earlier but want to ensure accuracy.
